activity_summary: At dusk you looked at the almanac on the sill. The thirtieth of March carried the mark of the new moon. Your tables stayed shut, and you wrote nothing.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the March leaf and left the tables shut.

entities.name: the penny almanac
entities.context: Mentioned in New moon in Lent

facets.activity: Saw the new moon marked and closed the almanac
